findings.claim: FY2025 10-K Item 3 描述的法律程序均為一般營運性訴訟，未列反壟斷調查或拆分事項。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 3 Legal Proceedings
findings.excerpt: We are from time to time party to various lawsuits, claims and other legal proceedings that arise in the ordinary course of business.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素提到對併購的反壟斷審查加嚴（FTC/DOJ、HSR 法等），可能影響部分潛在收購的成本、時程或完成能力；屬一般性風險揭露，非針對 Quanta 的調查。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: Furthermore, the increased antitrust scrutiny of and compliance requirements for potential acquisitions, including by the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) and Department of Justice under the Hart-Scott Rodino Act, the Sherman Act, the Clayton Act (each as amended) or other applicable laws, could negatively impact the cost and timing of or our ability to complete certain potential acquisitions.

findings.claim: 野火事件：Quanta 營運公司曾收到辯護通知、文件保全要求與傳票，未來可能有更多相關求償（產業特定責任風險，非反壟斷）。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: From time to time, Quanta operating companies have received tenders of defense, demands for preservation of documents and indemnity and subpoenas during the course of investigations and reviews of wildfire events

note: 三次網搜未發現 2026 年針對 PWR 的 DOJ/FTC/EU 反壟斷調查或拆分報導。
